integrity: The result is proved analytically in RESULT.md; numerical checks are supporting diagnostics and do not establish universal claims. Existing physical model ingredients and prior pulse-irrigation work are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for an initially fully recovered exponential wet-decay and dry-recovery infiltration capacity with capacity-saturating rain, instant runoff removal, fixed horizon and at most two wet segments separated by one dry segment. No claim for arbitrary multiple pulses, fixed rain-water dose, heterogeneous soil or Richards-equation hydrodynamics. Historical priority is provisional where original full texts were inaccessible.
title: A sharp horizon threshold and finite optimal rest for two-pulse Horton infiltration
